dimensions.name: OPPONENT_IS_FBS
dimensions.comment: True when the opponent is an FBS program. False marks FCS "buy games".

dimensions.name: CONFERENCE_NAME
dimensions.comment: The team's CURRENT conference; realignment history is not tracked here.

dimensions.name: IS_FBS
dimensions.comment: True for FBS programs (~134 of 536 teams). League-wide questions almost always mean FBS.

dimensions.name: HAS_BOX_SCORE
dimensions.comment: False for the handful of completed games whose yardage block is missing upstream; their scores and results are still real.

dimensions.name: IS_HOME
dimensions.comment: True when this row's team was the home side.

dimensions.name: IS_POSTSEASON
dimensions.comment: True for bowls and the College Football Playoff.

dimensions.name: RESULT
dimensions.comment: W, L or T from this team's perspective. Ties are historical rarities kept for correctness.

dimensions.name: SEASON
dimensions.comment: Season, 2024-2025 today; 2026 rows appear as games complete. January bowl games belong to the prior year's season.

dimensions.name: WEEK
dimensions.comment: Week 1-16 in the regular calendar. WEEK 999 IS THE POSTSEASON MARKER, not a week; filter is_postseason instead.

dimensions.name: WENT_TO_OVERTIME
dimensions.comment: True when the game needed overtime.

metrics.name: GAMES_PLAYED
metrics.comment: Rows counted. Correct for a single team's games; LEAGUE-WIDE this counts team-games (two per game), so halve it or count distinct games for "how many games were played".

metrics.name: TURNOVERS_PER_GAME
metrics.comment: Average turnovers committed, over games that have a box score.

metrics.name: WIN_PCT
metrics.comment: Share of games won across the grouped rows. Ties count as losses here; the standings view carries the official percentage.

metrics.name: YARDS_PER_GAME
metrics.comment: Average total yards, over games that have a box score.

facts.name: PASSING_YARDS
facts.comment: Team passing yards in the game.

facts.name: POINTS_SCORED
facts.comment: Points this team scored in the game.

facts.name: POINT_DIFFERENTIAL
facts.comment: points_scored minus points_allowed; negative in a loss.

facts.name: RUSHING_YARDS
facts.comment: Team rushing yards in the game.

facts.name: TOTAL_YARDS
facts.comment: Total offensive yards. NULL when the box score is missing upstream (see has_box_score).
